donationsAndForcedNative.note: No sweep exists; donated assets remain stranded by design.

chain56AndNoGenericPath.constructorAndCalls: Synthetic suite separately verifies chain fail-closed behavior
chain56AndNoGenericPath.pause: ABSENT; UI kill switch cannot stop direct calls

localFork.caveat: Local fork receipts are not mainnet transactions or proof of future execution.

designLimits.pool: One immutable POOL_FEE per deployment; no dynamic-best routing. Two-instance or new dual-tier candidate requires explicit owner scope and audit.
designLimits.pause: No on-chain pause or privileged role. A UI kill switch cannot prevent direct calls. Guardian pause requires a new separately frozen and audited candidate.
designLimits.donations: No sweep. Donated USDT/WBNB and forced native BNB are permanently unrecoverable and excluded from per-call settlement.
designLimits.mev: User minNetOut is net of fee; router amountOutMinimum is 1 because adapter performs final net check. Owner slippage/TTL/MEV policy remains unapproved.
designLimits.tokens: Exact balance deltas reject fee-on-transfer and unexpected output. USDT issuer powers remain external risks. XAUt is BLOCKED.
designLimits.native: Adapter wraps input BNB itself and unwraps only net output. USDT-to-BNB fee remains WBNB. Router native residue/refund paths are never used.
designLimits.approvals: Exact per-swap approval; post-router allowance must be zero or the transaction reverts.

launchGates.requirement: Reproduce the exact V1.6 source, compiler, ABI and bytecode hashes.
Independent third-party audit, fixes in a new frozen candidate if needed, and re-audit.
launchGates.blocker: No independent auditor engaged; six Slither HIGH traces remain open.

launchGates.requirement: Choose audited single-pool or separately frozen allowlisted 500/2500 per-quote pool design.
launchGates.blocker: V1.6 cannot dynamically select the better verified pool.

launchGates.requirement: Separate owner approval of exact BNB fee rate and chain-56 treasury address.
launchGates.blocker: Neither fee rate nor recipient is approved.

launchGates.requirement: Owner governance and emergency-response policy addressing the absence of on-chain pause.
launchGates.blocker: UI controls cannot stop direct contract calls.

launchGates.requirement: Slippage, deadline, order-size and MEV-protection policy.
launchGates.blocker: Research limits are not owner-approved execution policy.

launchGates.requirement: Token issuer/legal review, sustained pool liquidity and independent RPC quorum.
launchGates.blocker: USDT issuer/legal risk and same-operator RPC observations remain open.

launchGates.requirement: Remediate or explicitly risk-accept current production dependency advisories.
launchGates.blocker: Fresh dependency scan must be attached to the release review.

launchGates.requirement: Approved local/testnet rehearsal plus physical mobile-wallet signing and rejection checks.
launchGates.blocker: No funded rehearsal or physical-wallet acceptance.

launchGates.requirement: Separately authorized chain-56 deployment, multisig verification and capped canary.
launchGates.blocker: No deployment, multisig verification or canary authorization.

riskRegister.risk: No independent professional audit; six Slither HIGH traces require auditor disposition.
Single immutable pool tier cannot ensure best verified 500/2500 net output per trade.
No on-chain pause; UI disablement cannot stop direct contract interaction.
BNB fee rate and treasury recipient are unapproved; 5/10 bps are test proposals only.
Slippage, TTL, order limits and MEV policy lack owner approval and physical-wallet review.
USDT issuer/owner powers and legal terms are external to immutable adapter code.
XAUt upgrade/issuer/RWA restrictions; no generic token bypass exists.
Official observations use the same operator, not an independent quorum.
Fresh production dependency scan: 12 rows (4 high, 8 moderate); remediation not in this scope.
Physical mobile-wallet signing/rejection and separately authorized rehearsal are incomplete.
Gas and pool conditions vary; local receipt +63,293 gas and earlier +94,275 estimate are not guarantees.
Integer fee rounds down to zero for dust; minimum order policy is unapproved.
Donations and forced native are permanently stranded; no recovery exists.
No mainnet deployment, source verification, multisig check or capped canary authorization.
